fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: target peaks leak into visible inputs, N<20, official snapshot/lock missing, peak residual exceeds uncertainty, or comparator is not worse

incumbent_comparator.baseline_name: peak-shuffle and molecule-family median spectrum baseline
incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict peak positions/intensities from preregistered shuffled or family-median peak lists without reading hidden target peaks.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: peak-match residual must beat shuffled/family-median comparator residual

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

residual_requirement.formula: weighted mean of matched abs(predicted_wavenumber - observed_wavenumber) plus preregistered intensity penalty
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model weighted residual must beat comparator residual and meet declared cm^-1/intensity tolerances

residuals.material_margin_rule: model weighted residual must beat comparator residual and meet declared cm^-1/intensity tolerances

source.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source.source_name: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69 infrared spectrum records

target_variable.extraction_rule: Hide IR peak positions/intensities until a preregistered peak model is materialized from visible molecular identity and non-target metadata.
target_variable.name: infrared_peak_wavenumber_and_intensity

uncertainty_requirement.rule: Declare cm^-1 tolerance, intensity tolerance, and peak-matching policy before target opening.

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
